text:
toni.li: quick note 10: onboarding qiyu-lite-q8x showed a reproducible spacing regression for zh-Hant (TW). model emits no space between han and units (e.g., "元") more often than fp16.
yue.zhang: can you paste a tiny repro?
toni.li: input: "本年度預估收入為 5,200 元"
fp16 -> "本年度預估收入為 5,200 元"
q8x  -> "本年度預估收入為5,200元"  (spaces removed)
sam.oks: interesting, feels like token boundary collapse around number+unit. did you confirm tokenizer artifact sha identical?
toni.li: yes same tokenizer SHA. ran tokenizer-only: it outputs the same token sequence as fp16 when run standalone. so issue looks decode/detok-related.
anya.eval: I ran batch diffs: fp16 tokens: ["本年度", "預估", "收入", "為", " 5,200 ", " 元"] q8x tokens: ["本年度", "預估", "收入", "為5,200元"]
anya.eval: automated eval: BLEU_fp16(tw)=30.2 BLEU_q8x(tw)=24.7 mean_len_fp16=19.9 mean_len_q8x=18.5
sam.oks: kernel selection? any new int8 kernel fused ops?
toni.li: deploy log shows matmul kernel switched to qgemm_int8_v5 and an extra graph fuse pass 'numeric_span_fuse' ran in q8x transform.
yue.zhang: numeric_span_fuse seems suspicious. who added that? it was intended for Latin thousand separators, but might be over-eager in multilang.
sam.oks: try beam search vs greedy. if beam recovers spaces then it's decode preference, else detok/transform.
toni.li: ran beam=4 -> BLEU_q8x=26.1 (partial improvement). toggled runtime flag detok.legacy=true -> BLEU_q8x=28.9 (closer).
anya.eval: hypothesis: quantization rounding compresses logits near subword boundaries, combined with numeric_span_fuse merging adjacent tokens in the graph. detok then applies locale heuristic that strips spaces for merged numeric-unit token.
yue.zhang: action items: 1) disable numeric_span_fuse in q8x graph as quick experiment; 2) add 250-case zh-Hant numeric/unit suite (dates, currency, measurements) to nightly; 3) diff logits around boundary with fp16 vs q8x for failing samples.
sam.oks: I'll repro locally w/ qgemm_int8_v5 single-threaded and run the logits diff. ETA ~1h.
toni.li: I'll add the suite and a custom alert if BLEU delta > 3 for zh-Hant. opening PR and issue REDWOOD-ML-1402.
deploy-bot: CI run 5999991180: onboarding-q8x-smoke failed (regression threshold exceeded). Issue REDWOOD-ML-1402 created.
yue.zhang: long-term: numeric_span_fuse should be locale-aware and only enable for locales with Latin-style thousands/units. also detok heuristics need to prefer tokenizer-preserved spaces when span boundaries uncertain.
toni.li: agreed. I'll prototype a locale filter and add unit tests. will update thread when local repro done. :thumbsup:
